SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account2;

WITH last_month_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT evm_address
    FROM account2
    WHERE last_sent_epoch >= extract(epoch from current_date - interval '1 month')
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lma.evm_address IS NOT NULL THEN a.evm_address END) AS "Active Accounts",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lma.evm_address IS NULL THEN a.evm_address END) AS "Stale Accounts"
FROM
    account2 a
LEFT JOIN
    last_month_activity lma ON a.evm_address = lma.evm_address;
-- The CTE (Common Table Expression) named last_month_activity selects distinct Evmos addresses (evm_address) from the account2 table where the last transaction epoch is within the last month.
-- The main query counts the number of distinct Evmos addresses for both active and stale accounts using a LEFT JOIN with the last_month_activity CTE.
-- This query assumes that the timestamp-related columns (first_detected_epoch, last_sent_epoch, etc.) are stored as epoch timestamps (seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 24 Hours"
FROM
  account2
WHERE
  first_sent_epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day');

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 7 Days"
FROM
  account2
WHERE
  first_sent_epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 week');

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 30 Days"
FROM
  account2
WHERE
  first_sent_epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month');

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Last 60 Days"
FROM
  account2
WHERE
  first_sent_epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '2 month');

SELECT
    t.account_address,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(t.t_value_h + t.t_value_l*POWER(10, -18)) AS "Volume in EVMOS"
FROM (
    SELECT
        UNNEST(involved_accounts_addresses) AS account_address, t_value_h, t_value_l
    FROM
        transaction_58 
    WHERE
        epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - 
            CASE 
                WHEN $time_interval = 'day' THEN INTERVAL '1 day'
                WHEN $time_interval = 'week' THEN INTERVAL '1 week'
                WHEN $time_interval = 'month' THEN INTERVAL '1 month'
                ELSE INTERVAL '1 month'
            END
        )
) AS t
JOIN
    account2 a ON t.account_address = a.evm_address
GROUP BY
    t.account_address
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

), xen_contracts AS (
    SELECT UNNEST(ARRAY[
        '0x9ec13dcf66f72035fbb4cd2eb42a1566fd54d2b7',
        '0x4c4cf206465abfe5cecb3b581f50e8ec514692',

    SELECT DISTINCT evm_from

    SELECT DISTINCT evm_from

SELECT a.proposal_id, a."option", count(1) AS "count_participation_with_vote" FROM (
        SELECT 
                m."content"->>'proposal_id' AS "proposal_id",
                CASE
                        WHEN m."content"->>'option' = 'VOTE_OPTION_YES' THEN 'YES'
                        WHEN m."content"->>'option' = 'VOTE_OPTION_ABSTAIN' THEN 'ABSTAIN'
                        ELSE 'NO' -- treat both NO and NO WITH VETO as NO
                END AS "option"
        FROM $message_partition m
        LEFT JOIN transaction_55 t ON m.transaction_hash = t.hash AND m.height = t.height
        WHERE m."type" IN ('cosmos.gov.v1.MsgVote', 'cosmos.gov.v1beta1.MsgVote') -- BOTH proto message versions
                AND t.osuccess IS TRUE -- success txs only
) a
GROUP BY a.proposal_id, a."option"
ORDER BY a.proposal_id DESC, a."option" ASC;

SELECT
    sc.addr,
    SUM(t.gas_used) AS total_gas_used
FROM
    smart_contract sc
JOIN
    $transaction_partition t ON sc.creator_evm_addr = ANY (t.involved_accounts_addresses)
WHERE
    sc.verified_epoch IS NOT NULL 
    AND sc.verified_epoch > 0
    AND t.epoch >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - 
        CASE 
            WHEN $time_interval = 'day' THEN INTERVAL '1 day'
            WHEN $time_interval = 'week' THEN INTERVAL '1 week'
            WHEN $time_interval = 'month' THEN INTERVAL '1 month'
            ELSE INTERVAL '1 month'
        END )
GROUP BY
    sc.addr
ORDER BY total_gas_used DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'distribution') AS "Distribution",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'ethermint') AS "Ethermint",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'gov') AS "Governance",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'staking') AS "Staking",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = '0x') AS "EVM",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'ibc') AS "IBC",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'rt') AS "RT",
  COUNT(hash) FILTER (WHERE category = 'other') AS "Other"
FROM (
  SELECT
    hash,
    CASE
      WHEN type_summary LIKE '%distribution%' THEN 'distribution'
      WHEN type_summary LIKE '%ethermint%' THEN 'ethermint'
      WHEN type_summary LIKE '%gov%' THEN 'gov'
  		WHEN type_summary LIKE '%staking%' THEN 'staking'
 		  WHEN type_summary LIKE '%0x%' THEN '0x'
  		WHEN type_summary LIKE '%ibc%' THEN 'ibc'
      WHEN type_summary LIKE 'RT' THEN 'rt'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS category
  FROM
    $transaction_partition
) AS categorized_transactions;

SELECT

    JOIN smart_contract s ON s.creator_evm_addr = ANY(combined.involved_accounts_addresses)

    GROUP BY day
) AS daily_transactions;
